# The first two runs of a Ledger Nano X's SSD1306 link: the boot, and the frame
# after it. Cut from a logic analyser capture of the user's device with its `dc`
# wire connected, so the tags are what the wire said (4 November 2026).
#   c ..   command bytes, in hexadecimal
#   d ..   data bytes, in hexadecimal; `xx*n` is n of them
#   s      a silence: 252 us, 7.7 ms and 2 s on the wire, in that order
